title: Line Multigraphs of General Hypergraphs
summary: A line multigraph is obtained from a hypergraph by taking its hyperedges as vertices and joining two of them by as many edges as the number of vertices they share. We develop a matrix theory for line multigraphs of general, not necessarily uniform, hypergraphs. The central tool is the identity $\mathbf{B}^\mathrm{T}\mathbf{B} = \mathbf{C} + \mathbf{A}_{\mathcal{L}}$, where $\mathbf{B}$ is the incidence matrix, $\mathbf{C}$ is the diagonal matrix of hyperedge cardinalities and $\mathbf{A}_{\mathcal{L}}$ is the adjacency matrix of the line multigtaph.
